author: DonaldMyTrump
body: Hello. On TeamSpeak there is a major divide between Spanish and English speaking users, which results in harassment, bullying and general misbehavior. My suggestion is that we build a wall between the two chats and give ranks that allow for users to go into their respective language oriented chats. For users who can speak both once proven to be fluent in both languages, they will be given permissions to move into both types of rooms. Feedback is appreciated!

replies.author: SnowSX3
replies.body:
I don't think encouraging separation is good for our very small community.
If you see harassment occur in the TeamSpeak channels, report it to a staff member with appropriate evidence.

replies.author: gobernment
replies.body:
Limiting players would cause even more of a divide, there's no logic in this post. I've never seen any problems with actual spanish players ruining English chats. The names are just a guideline anyway, as we "prefer" that language. We also don't need more unnecessary ranks to keep up after.

This will not happen, therefore I am locking it. Suggestion declined.
